eligibility_criteria: A Bachelor’s degree with minimum aggregate of 50%. Admission will be done through SRM Joint Entrance Examination for Management (SRMJEEM) followed by a Personal Interview. Students with eligible entrance scores in CAT/XAT/MAT/GMAT/NMAT/CMAT/TANCET will be granted direct consideration for the personal interview. Preference would be given to candidates with work experience.
about_program: MBA programme offered by SRM Institute of Science and Technology with focus on sports management.
career_opportunities: Sports Management, Sports Marketing, Event Management, Sports Operations, Sponsorship & Partnerships
